name: B10-0436/2026 – After § 6 – Am 8
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the pilot project on European Schools Alliances
part_text: 6b. Calls on the Commission to support educational approaches that preserve and promote the study of classical languages, literature, philosophy and history, recognising their contribution to linguistic proficiency, logical reasoning, historical understanding and critical thought, and to ensure that the European Schools Alliances contribute to safeguarding Europe’s classical intellectual and cultural heritage;
